_comment: z.ai GLM Coding Plan (subscription; opencode login `zai-coding-plan`, or ZAI_API_KEY for the claude runtime; quota adapter `zai`). Mind the plan's peak-hour multiplier. Merge the profiles you need into .lean-worker/profiles.json and replace the {build command} / {test command} placeholders. Each chain ends in Claude: it runs only when the operator gives the go on an `escalate:` line. Bash runs only the allowedTools patterns and every segment of a pipeline must match, so the common read-only helpers are pre-approved. Give code tasks --write-scope: these models have edited files outside the task's scope. Review a change with a model of another family than the one that wrote it (for example review-<other family>, or the base template's Claude review). Runtime is claude (the plan's Anthropic-compatible endpoint), so an escalation to Claude stays in the same runtime; "runtime": "opencode" also works and starts with a smaller context.
